name: IELTS API
description: A free, open, no-authentication REST API for IELTS preparation research: Cambridge IELTS 1-22 vocabulary, analytic band descriptors, score concordances, task banks, a canonical question-type taxonomy with observed frequencies, a structure and readability index of 1,702 practice tests, an indexed open research corpus, a grey-literature archive index of the Cambridge 1-18 listening audio, the official sample tasks and 24 marked learner essays, validated raw-score to band conversion tables, a mock-exam test-centre index of an operational IELTS online test centre with 1,099 hand-tagged question groups and a production score calibration, and a community wordbook index cross-validated against the Cambridge list with a data-quality audit and a stateless Ebbinghaus spaced-repetition scheduler.
